name: Nanaka Matsurida
source: Cheerful and a mile cocky, Nanaka is the younger Matsurida sister and next in line for Wereihia's throne. She's at that age where she wants to show off how adult she is, so she ends up making a fool of herself more often than not. Still, she can be serious when she wants to, and hopes to be a proper ruler when she grows up.
